# Sains Humanika

> Sains Humanika is an academic journal published by Penerbit UTM Press that bridges humanities and sciences through peer-reviewed research and scholarly publication.

Sains Humanika is an open-access academic journal managed through Open Journal Systems and indexed in SCOPUS. The journal serves as a platform for researchers at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia and beyond to publish interdisciplinary research spanning humanities and sciences.
